item.title: Modern Food Photography Site Revamp
item.description:
250-750 USD | My photography portfolio needs a complete refresh, and I want the result to feel unmistakably modern and minimalist. I'm transitioning to food/drink photography from landscape/travel. My URL is https://fholmstock.com and my Instagram page is https://www.instagram.com/fholmstock/
I want to use the website as a portfolio to market my photography services the restaurants and caterers. The project spans three areas at once:
• Design overhaul – from layout, typography, and colour palette to subtle micro-interactions, everything should echo clean lines, generous whitespace, and let the imagery speak first. • Content update – I will supply a new collection of high-resolution food shots plus revised copy; you’ll handle the uploads, optimisation, and placement so each page looks balanced and on brand. • Functionality improvements – smoother gallery navigation, a faster, mobile-first experience, and any smart touches (lightbox, filter tags, refined contact page) that make browsing intuitive.
We’ll start with a quick audit of the existing site, move to wireframes/mock-ups for sign-off, then build, test, and deploy with no visible downtime. Final deliverables: redesigned site pushed live, all new photos and text integrated, performance optimised, and basic hand-off notes so I can manage future content easily.
Please share links to comparable work—particularly minimalist portfolio or photography sites—and outline the tools or CMS you’re comfortable using. Let’s bring this portfolio up to date and let the images shine.

item.title: Lead-Generating IDX Realtor Website
item.description:
250-750 CAD | I’m launching a brand-new real estate site and the single most important outcome is a steady stream of qualified leads. To make that happen, I need an experienced developer who can build the site from the ground up, integrate a reliable IDX feed, and craft a fast, mobile-friendly user experience that encourages visitors to raise their hand.
The site’s core lead-capture elements must include: • Contact forms that store inquiries in a CRM or database I can access easily • Real-time live chat support (embed of a service like Tawk.to, LiveChat, or a comparable solution) • A robust property search interface powered by the IDX feed so users can filter, save, and share listings
Everything should be set up on a CMS that lets me add content, neighborhoods, and blog posts without touching code. Clean on-page SEO, responsive design, and analytics tagging are expected so I can measure performance from day one.
Please outline your preferred tech stack, past IDX projects, and an estimated timeline for handing over a launch-ready site.

item.title: WooCommerce
item.description:
20-250 GBP | I already have WooCommerce and the FooEvents plugin installed on my WordPress site. The goal is to mirror the experience Ticket Tailor offers for our customers —nothing more, nothing less—so visitors can browse events, choose tickets, pay seamlessly, and receive automatic e-tickets.
Here is what I need you to set up:
• Ticketing system – create ticket types, quantities, prices, and automated e-ticket delivery. • Event management – front-end event listings with date, venue, capacity tracking, and attendee export. • Payment processing – integrate my existing payment gateway so transactions flow through WooCommerce and generate receipts.
The plugins are in place; your task is to configure them, map the necessary WooCommerce settings, and style the event pages so they feel cohesive with the rest of my site. No bespoke features are required beyond what Ticket Tailor normally provides, so please stick to native WooCommerce and FooEvents options wherever possible.
Acceptance criteria: a test event that can be browsed, purchased, and checked in; attendee CSV export functions correctly; emails and e-tickets reach the buyer; and order data appears in the WooCommerce dashboard.
Once the above is working smoothly, hand over any short how-to notes so I can duplicate the process for future events. I want someone who can work on this now and complete over the weekend.

item.title: Website Design Fix & SEO Boost
item.description:
250-750 USD | Our site’s layout is holding back both user experience and search visibility, so I need a designer-developer who can refine the look of every key page while weaving in solid SEO foundations. The priority is design and layout: tightening spacing, improving visual hierarchy, and making sure the Home, product/service, and contact-style pages all guide visitors (and Google) cleanly through the content.
Once the visuals are right, I want full-spectrum SEO—on-page, off-page, and technical. Expect to polish metadata and copy, speed up loading, check schema, and outline a backlink strategy that makes sense for our niche. If a small navigation tweak or broken element pops up during the process, feel free to tidy that as well; the goal is a seamless, search-friendly site.
Deliverables: • Updated page templates reflecting the new layout • Documented on-page optimisations (titles, headings, alt text, internal links) • Technical improvements pushed live (speed, mobile, indexability) • A concise action plan for off-page work and ongoing growth
I’m happy to supply current theme files, access to the CMS, and a ranking report so you can measure progress. Let me know your estimated turnaround and any standout successes you’ve had with similar revamps.

item.title: Upgrade Wix Store & Square
item.description:
1500-3000 USD | I have a basic Wix site online, but it still looks and feels like a draft. My priority is to turn it into a polished store that drives sales. The first area that needs work is how the products are displayed—right now the listings feel scattered and hard to browse, so I want a clear, intuitive structure that encourages visitors to add items to the cart.
Alongside the visual and organizational overhaul, I need seamless Square payment integration. Customers should be able to complete checkout without leaving the site, with inventory and order data flowing cleanly between Wix and Square. If you’ve linked these two platforms before, you’ll know the quirks to watch for, and that expertise will be invaluable here.
Deliverables I expect: • Re-organized product catalog with logical categories and easy filters/search • Refreshed page layout and styling that stays on-brand but feels more professional • Full Square payment setup, tested end-to-end—including any required API keys, webhooks, and confirmation emails
Once everything is live, I should be able to add or edit products myself without breaking the layout, and customers should enjoy a smooth, trustworthy checkout experience. If this sounds like a straightforward project for you, let’s get started—you’ll have direct access to my Wix dashboard as soon as we agree on the timeline.

item.title: Migrate SouthernSkies.biz to Shopify
item.description:
250-750 USD | I recently took over SouthernSkies.biz and the moment a shopper clicks “Shop” they land on an outdated e-commerce system the previous owner never updated. I want every part of that store rebuilt on Shopify so I can manage prices, add or remove products, and track inventory without wrestling with legacy code.
Here is what I need from you: • Complete product migration – copy all current listings, descriptions, photos, variants, and SEO data into Shopify, making sure nothing is lost in the move. • A functioning Shopify storefront set up with payment, shipping, tax, and basic inventory tracking configured. • A clean theme installed and customised just enough to match my existing Southern Skies branding (I’m open to a proven template or light custom tweaks—whichever keeps costs down). • Guidance on using the Shopify dashboard so I can handle future updates myself.
I’m a first-time owner with a limited budget, so please give me a clear, itemised quote for the build and migration only; ongoing maintenance will be on my side once the hand-off is complete.
If this sounds straightforward for you, let’s talk timeline and get SouthernSkies.biz flying smoothly on Shopify.

item.title: WordPress Site Build & Design
item.description:
30-250 AUD | I’m ready to launch a new WordPress website. What I need now is a developer-designer who can turn that into a polished, fully functional site that reflects my brand.
I have a mockup and graphics. Tailoring colours, typography and layout so everything feels cohesive. I’ll supply the logo, imagery and copy; you’ll organise them into a clear structure, create the core pages (Home, About, Services/Products, Blog, Contact) and make sure the site looks great on desktop, tablet and mobile.
Part of the brief also includes configuring essential plugins for security, caching and SEO, setting up clean permalinks, and making any light CSS or PHP tweaks needed to hit the final design. Once the site is live, a short walkthrough—either a quick call, screencast or concise PDF—will help me manage updates on my own.
Deliverables • Theme and child theme installed, configured and branded • Up to five main pages populated with my content • Responsive design checked across major browsers and devices • Key plugins for security, caching and on-page SEO installed and set up • Basic performance optimisation (image compression, minification where practical) • Post-launch walkthrough or guide for future edits
If you’ve recently customised a client-supplied theme, send over one or two links so I can see your approach. I’m aiming for a clean, fast site and a smooth hand-off once everything is complete.
<Must be able to create as per design mockup

item.title: WordPress SEO Setup aireagua.mx
item.description:
250-750 USD | My WordPress site aireagua.mx is live but still runs on the platform’s default SEO settings. I want to get the All in One SEO Pack properly configured, align every key page with the keyword list I already prepared, and lay the groundwork for sustainable backlink growth.
Here is the work I need completed:
• Configure and fine-tune All in One SEO Pack across the whole site, including XML sitemaps, schema markup, meta titles and descriptions, social previews, robots.txt and basic speed tweaks that impact crawlability. • Map my existing keyword list to the current page architecture, then weave those terms naturally into headings, copy, alt tags and internal links so each page earns a solid green score inside the plugin. • Audit content for on-page improvements—readability, keyword density, image optimisation—then implement the fixes directly in WordPress. • Deliver an initial backlink boost: identify relevant high-authority sites, secure quality links (no spam), and document placements in a short report so I can track future growth.
Acceptance criteria: every indexed page should pass the All in One SEO Pack analysis without critical warnings; Google Search Console must detect the updated sitemap; and the backlink report should list live URLs only.
Access to WordPress and the keyword sheet will be granted as soon as we start. Let me know your proposed timeline and anything else you need to hit the ground running.

Requirements: - Make changes to current designs
Ideal Skills and Experience: - Proficiency in WordPress - Strong design skills - Experience with page template modification

item.title: Finish Madagascar Tour Booking Site
item.description:
30-250 USD | I have already set up the framework for madatease.com, a Madagascar-focused tourism platform, and I’m now looking for a WordPress specialist to take it from “almost there” to launch-ready within roughly two weeks.
Scope of work – Configure and display 12 tour packages, each priced in EUR, with selectable add-ons and optional experiences. – Build booking request forms that capture party size plus precise start and end dates. – Create a private-driver portal where chauffeurs can register, upload documents, and keep an availability calendar up to date. – Expand the admin dashboard so I can approve or decline bookings, trigger payment links, and see driver availability at a glance. – Add modules for airport transfers and stand-alone day trips. – Insert pre-supplied hotel affiliate links throughout the relevant pages. – Ensure everything looks and works perfectly on mobile.
Key tech expectations You are comfortable marrying a mature WordPress booking plugin to custom driver-portal logic, and you can wire the payment-link flow (Stripe or similar) without fuss. Clean, maintainable code and frictionless UX are non-negotiable.
Timeline Ideally 10–14 days from kickoff. If you need longer, explain why and outline milestones.
When you reply • Quote a fixed price with a clear breakdown of what is included. • Share two or three relevant builds (tourism, booking systems, multi-vendor or driver portals). • Confirm which booking plugin you recommend and why it suits these requirements. • Outline how you will test and hand over the finished site.
I will supply the full development brief, all tour copy, images, design files, and access credentials the moment we agree. I’m ready to move quickly—please review the existing site before you quote so we can hit the ground running.

item.title: Moving Company Booking Website
item.description:
250-750 USD | I operate a newly launched moving, hauling, and eviction-clean-out service and now need a web presence that feels as modern and sleek as the trucks we drive. The site’s primary goal is to turn visitors into booked jobs by showing exactly what we do, letting them choose a time slot, and taking payment on the spot.
Scope of the build • Design language: clean, contemporary typography, bold imagery, intuitive navigation—mobile-first is a must. • Core pages: – Services: present each service—standard moves, removal hauling, eviction cleanouts—with detailed descriptions I can edit later. – Scheduling: embed a real-time calendar where customers can pick a date, confirm the booking, and pay a deposit or the full amount. – Contact Us: quick-fill form plus clickable phone number and map.
Functional requirements • Seamless booking engine connected to a payment gateway (Stripe, Square, or similar). • Automated email or SMS confirmations and reminders. • Simple dashboard so I can adjust available time slots and add new service details without touching code. • Fast load times and basic on-page SEO so we appear when locals search for movers.
Acceptance criteria 1. I can add or edit a service description from the admin panel and see the change live immediately. 2. A test booking flows through from calendar selection to successful payment and confirmation email. 3. Site renders correctly on at least the latest versions of Chrome, Safari, and a standard Android browser.
Hand-off items should include all source files, admin credentials, and a short Loom or PDF guide that walks me through routine edits. If you already have a preferred CMS or booking plugin that nails this workflow, tell me—flexibility is fine as long as it remains sleek and user-friendly.

item.title: Creative Consulting Agency Website
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I’m ready to launch a fresh, creative-looking Wix site that introduces me and my consulting agency, walks visitors through three distinct service branches, and doubles as a small digital storefront.
Here’s the experience I have in mind: • A dynamic home page that quickly tells my story and links clearly to each service branch. • Three dedicated pages (or tabs) – one per branch – each with its own copy, imagery, and call-to-action. • An e-commerce section where clients can buy self-paced video courses, live or recorded webinars, and book 1-to-1 Zoom/Google Meet sessions. I need Credit/Debit card, PayPal, and Bank Transfer options running smoothly through Wix’s checkout. • A topic-specific blog I can update myself. • A resources area laid out like an alphabetical dictionary so visitors can jump straight to the term they need. • A flexible contact form with an open text field so prospects can describe their situation in detail. • A spotlight section to showcase upcoming speaking gigs and conference appearances, with room for images, dates, and links.
The overall vibe must stay creative and modern—from typography to color palette—while still making navigation effortless on both desktop and mobile. I’ll supply brand content and initial copy; you handle design, Wix setup, basic SEO, and a short hand-off guide so I can maintain everything moving forward.
Additional Requirements: • Secure hosting for training videos with restricted access to prevent unauthorized sharing. • Integration of paywalls or password protection for video access. • Capability to upload small clips for promotional use on Instagram or TikTok.

item.title: Realtor Voice Search SEO Boost
item.description:
30-250 CAD | I want to make sure that when someone asks a smart speaker or AI assistant for “the best realtor in [City]” – or how to buy or sell a house quickly here – my name is the answer they hear.
I’m already ranking well in traditional search; now I need an expert who understands voice-first optimisation for Amazon Alexa, Google Assistant and Apple Siri, and who can also position my brand inside conversational AI environments such as ChatGPT, Claude and Microsoft Copilot.
The job centres on three core phrases: • “Best realtor in [City]” • “Buy houses in [City]” • “Sell my house quickly in [City]”
You’ll review my existing site and local listings, then refine copy, metadata and Schema.org markup so each phrase surfaces naturally in voice results. If creating an Alexa Skill, Google Action or Siri Shortcut will strengthen visibility, map out what that build would look like and how it plugs into my current WordPress site and CRM. I also expect guidance on optimising my Google Business Profile, adding FAQ-style content, and ensuring page speed and mobile friendliness meet Core Web Vitals.
My acceptance criteria are straightforward: 1. Featured snippets or rich answers for each target phrase in standard Google voice queries. 2. Consistent, correct invocation of my brand on Alexa, Google Assistant and Siri when users ask the above questions. 3. A brief playbook explaining how to keep the optimisation current as market conditions change.
If you’ve previously ranked local businesses through structured data, local SEO and voice assistant integration, I’d love to see the results and hear your strategy for applying the same success to my realtor services.

item.title: Automated Notion Blog Workflow
item.description:
20-250 GBP | I want to turn raw notes that already live inside my Notion workspace into polished, publish-ready blog posts complete with on-brand images. I’m looking for an end-to-end AI workflow that, at the click of a button, can: pull a page or database item from Notion, analyse the content, draft a coherent article, generate (or source) at least one relevant image, and return everything to Notion or a connected CMS in a clean, formatted state.
The AI must produce both text and images. I have no fixed preference on the underlying models or tools, so feel free to recommend whatever stack—GPT-3/4, Claude, DALL-E, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, custom fine-tuned models, Zapier or Make for orchestration—best balances quality, speed, and cost. What matters is that the flow remains reliable, requires minimal ongoing maintenance, and can scale as my content volume grows.
In your response, include a detailed project proposal outlining: • the architecture you recommend (APIs, automations, plugins, scripts) • how you’ll handle style consistency, SEO considerations, and image licensing or attribution • what the user interface or trigger will look like inside Notion • milestones, testing plan, and estimated turnaround
I’ll provide sample notes and brand guidelines once we kick off. Deliverables are the working workflow, documented setup instructions, and a short loom walk-through so I can replicate or tweak it later.

item.title: Minimalist One-Page Company Website
item.description:
20-250 GBP | I’m looking to launch a clean, single-page site that presents my packaging company at a glance. The sole purpose is to provide clear company information, so I want the layout ultra-minimal, quick to load and easy to navigate.
Content flow 1. About Us – a concise snapshot of our story and values. 2. Products & Services – short descriptions supported by product photos I’ll supply. 3. Contact Information – a simple form that sends enquiries straight to my email, plus our address and phone number.
Design & build notes • White space, muted brand colours and modern typography are key. • Fully responsive on desktop, tablet and mobile. • Light tech stack is fine: pure HTML/CSS, or wordpress is fine • No heavy animations—subtle scroll or fade effects only if they don’t slow the page.
Deliverable A production-ready, one-page website with all assets and a brief hand-off guide showing me how to update text or images.
When you apply, please link to past minimalist or single-page sites you’ve created so I can judge style and code quality quickly.

item.title: ADA Compliance for Non-Profit Website
item.description:
250-750 USD | I need an experienced developer to update our Wildapricot website for ADA compliance. This is for a non-profit organization.
Key requirements: - Make the site accessible for screen readers, keyboard navigation, and voice recognition. - Update navigation and menus, images and media, and forms and interactive elements.
Ideal skills and experience: - Proven experience with ADA compliance - Familiarity with Wildapricot - Knowledge of accessibility standards and best practices - Experience with assistive technologies
I would also like to have the option for occasional updates or maintenance after the initial work is done.

item.title: Port AI-Generated HTML Web Page to WordPress Elementor with SEO & Documentation
item.description:
30-250 CAD | I need a skilled freelancer to port my AI-generated HTML web page to WordPress using Elementor. The Golf Industry site must match the original design and be fully mobile responsive. The freelancer will need to extract all content and assets from the current live site. Tasks include: - Complete setup of the page on my hosting - Replicating layout and functionality in Elementor - Ensuring full mobile responsiveness - Setting up basic on-page SEO (titles, meta descriptions) - Providing clear instructions and documentation for future edits
Ideal freelancer will have experience with Elementor, WordPress migrations, and SEO best practices. Attention to detail and strong communication skills are essential. Background and strong knowledge of the game of golf, specifically golf course websites is important but not required.

item.title: Wix Website Redesign for Wellness Brand
item.description:
250-750 GBP | Description:
I'm Rich, a UK author and founder of Metanoia, a brand built around mental strength and inner discipline. It includes books, a newsletter, coaching programmes and a clothing line. I need an experienced Wix designer to rebuild my existing site, metanoiatransformation.com, so that it sells.
What the site must do
• Sell three things: clothing, coaching programmes and books. • Show two books as "coming soon", with a waitlist sign-up on each. • Offer a free Week 1 download in exchange for an email address, connected to my newsletter on Beehiiv. • Work well on a phone first.
What I need built
1. A new homepage: a hero, three doors (Book, Course, Clothing), a free-sample sign-up, a short "how it works" section and a newsletter box. 2. Pages for coaching, the two books, an About page and a Contact page. 3. A shop connected to print-on-demand (I'll confirm the supplier), with product pages, sizing, shipping and returns. 4. Navigation by what a visitor wants to do: Start here, Course, Book, Shop, Letter. 5. Basic SEO, fast loading and a cookie banner and privacy page that meet UK GDPR rules.
Design I'll supply a brand sheet and a brand identity document with exact colours, fonts and logo files. The look is natural and calm: linen and sand backgrounds, a warm brown for text, and a small amount of pale green. No black, and no loud or "hustle" styling. Headlines are in Cormorant Garamond and body text in Inter. Please don't use stock templates that look generic.
What I'll provide: logo files, colours, fonts, copy for the main pages, and product details as they are ready.
Who I'm looking for
• Proven Wix and Wix Stores experience, with links to two or three live sites close to this brief. • Print-on-demand shop experience, ideally in the UK. • Clean, editorial design. • Clear communication in English.
To apply, please:
• Send two relevant examples. • Confirm what is included in your price: pages, revisions (I expect at least two rounds) and handover, including a short video showing me how to edit the site myself. • Give a timeline in working days and what you need from me. • Say whether you will work in my existing Wix account.
Budget: [your budget] fixed price, paid in milestones: homepage, then remaining pages, then shop.
I'd suggest starting the contract with the homepage and waitlist only, and adding the shop in a second contract once the products are ready.

item.title: Wine Education Website Development
item.description:
20-250 GBP | I'm seeking a skilled web developer to create an informative and engaging website for my wine education and consultancy services. The primary purpose of the site is to educate visitors about wines, while also showcasing my wine tasting sessions and consultancy services.
Key Features Required: - Comprehensive Education Section: This will include articles, blogs, video tutorials, and infographics on various wine topics. - Services Showcase: Detailed descriptions of wine tasting sessions and wine consultancy services. - User-Friendly Navigation: The site should be easy to navigate, ensuring visitors can effortlessly find the information they need. - Responsive Design: The website must be mobile-friendly and look great on all devices. - SEO Optimization: To ensure the site ranks well on search engines and attracts a broad audience.
Ideal Skills and Experience: - Proven experience in developing educational websites, with a portfolio to showcase. - Strong SEO knowledge and implementation skills. - Expertise in creating user-friendly, responsive designs. - Excellent content organization and navigation structuring abilities.
Please provide a portfolio with your bid.

item.title: Healthy Eating Website and Blog
item.description:
250-750 USD | I need a clean, responsive website dedicated to healthy eating. The core of the build is a searchable, filter-friendly recipe database where visitors can quickly find dishes by ingredient, dietary preference, or prep time. Alongside the recipes, I want an easy-to-update blog section for articles, tips, and success stories.
A CMS such as WordPress, Ghost, or a similarly straightforward platform is fine as long as I can add new recipes and posts without touching code. Please structure the database so each recipe has its own page, categories, tags, nutrition facts, and a printable view. The blog should share the same design language and SEO setup.
Key deliverables • Fully responsive website (desktop, tablet, mobile) • Recipe database with advanced search/filter and nutrition fields • Blog section integrated into the same CMS • Modern, lightweight design tuned for fast load times • Basic on-page SEO (schema for recipes, meta tags, clean URLs) • Clear documentation or a quick video walk-through showing me how to add content
Nice-to-have (not required but mention if you can handle it): an interactive meal planner that could plug into the recipe data later.
I expect clean code, scoped CSS/utility classes, and accessibility best practices. Let me know your preferred stack, any relevant portfolio links, and an estimated timeline from kickoff to launch.

item.title: Wix E-Commerce Store With Chat
item.description:
250-750 GBP | I need a complete Wix-based online store that will let me sell physical products seamlessly. The key requirement is a built-in live-chat feature so I can answer customer questions in real time and boost conversions.
I already have a Wix account and a product list ready to upload; what I am missing is a visually appealing, mobile-responsive storefront, intuitive navigation, secure checkout, and the chat integration configured to match my brand’s look and feel. If you can also suggest apps or settings inside Wix that optimise inventory tracking, taxes, and shipping, that would be a bonus.
Once the site is live I’d like a quick walkthrough or short loom video covering how to add new items, process orders, and manage the chat dashboard, so I can run the store myself without constant developer help.
Deliverables: • Fully designed Wix store for physical goods • Live chat set up and styled • Payment and shipping rules configured and tested • Admin hand-off guide or video
If you have experience launching product-focused Wix sites with real-time support, I’m eager to see your portfolio and timeline.

item.title: Simple Scalable E-commerce Site
item.description:
1500-3000 USD | I'm looking for an experienced developer to create a small e-commerce store with either Shopify or WooCommerce on WordPress. The site will initially feature one product with three skus, but I need it to be scalable to accommodate additional products and skus in the future.

Design: I already have a logo but I'm unsure about the website design style. I’m open to suggestions that complement my brand.

item.title: Business Portal with Product Catalog
item.description:
250-750 USD | I need a clean, professional-looking business portal and help securing an appropriate domain name for it. The site’s primary purpose is to showcase our range of products, so the catalog must be front-and-center and easy for non-technical staff to update. At this stage I do not want online payments or a shopping-cart flow—products only need clear photos, descriptions, SKUs and a simple enquiry button that can route to our sales inbox.
Please handle the full set-up, from registering the domain through to launching the site on a live host. I am flexible on the platform (WordPress, Laravel, custom React, etc.) as long as it stays lightweight, mobile-friendly and SEO-ready. A straightforward CMS dashboard for adding new items and editing content is essential.
Deliverables: • Domain name registered and pointed to hosting • Responsive business portal deployed and tested • Product catalog section with add/edit capability, no payment gateway • Basic on-page SEO and submission to search engines • Brief hand-off guide so my team can maintain the catalog
If anything in the scope needs clarification, let me know—I’d like to move quickly once the domain is secured.

item.title: Mobile Personal Finance Website Partner - Palestine
item.description:
1000-20000 USD | I am building a mobile-first website that allows users to track their debts in one place. The goal is to launch a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) quickly, followed by continuous development and improvement. I am looking for a highly skilled developer interested in a long-term partnership. Given the nature of the work during this initial phase, the developer must be based in Palestine.
Core Scope of Work: • Design and develop a responsive web application that provides a seamless user experience, similar to a native mobile app. • Build a secure user registration system, including Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA). • Develop core modules for personal finance management: adding and editing transactions, categorizing expenses, and a clear dashboard displaying balances and spending trends. • Establish a scalable back-end architecture and well-structured APIs, with comprehensive code documentation to facilitate the addition of new features post-launch.
I am open to using any tech stack that enables rapid development and future scalability—for example, React or Vue for the front-end, and Node, Laravel, or a similar framework for the back-end. I place a high priority on clean architecture, robust test coverage, and efficient deployment mechanisms (such as Docker and CI/CD pipelines).
Required Deliverables for the Initial Phase: 1. A fully responsive front-end integrated with an efficient database. 2. A comprehensive system for account creation, login, and password recovery, secured with multi-factor authentication (MFA). 3. Interfaces for adding, editing, and categorizing financial transactions, along with a dashboard that summarizes the data. 4. Delivery of the source code via a private repository, accompanied by a brief session to hand over the project and explain its details.
If you are a developer based in Palestine and are interested in co-founding a product and contributing to its growth, let’s discuss the next steps, timelines, and how to structure this partnership.

item.title: WordPress Development & SEO Expert Needed- 6
item.description:
30-250 USD | SEO & WEBSITE DEVELOPER (WordPress) — Remote, Monthly Pay
About Us Our Company helps entrepreneurs start and grow their businesses. Our wordpress website is our storefront, and organic search is a core growth channel. We are hiring one person to own both: keep our WordPress site running perfectly and grow qualified organic traffic that turns into leads, sign-ups, and customers.
Starting Pay $300 USD per month, paid monthly. Pay is earned by completing the listed tasks and metrics on a signed weekly checklist, released after a 4-week+ review, paid upon completion of KPI metrics.
Schedule Flexible remote, fixed hours workday with a 30-minute lunch. Daily short written update to Admin; weekly report every Friday.
What You Will Do
Website Developer (WordPress site health) - Keep every page working perfectly on mobile, tablet, and desktop: no broken layouts, menus, images, links, or forms. - Test login, sign-up, password reset, order buttons, checkout, and all forms end to end. - Keep page speed under 3 seconds and Core Web Vitals green. - Run plugin, theme, and WordPress core updates on staging first, with a current backup, then apply live. - Fix issues the same day or escalate with a screenshot and page URL. - Weekly cross-browser check (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge).
SEO & Organic Growth - Publish 100 SEO-optimized templated pages per month (25 per week) through our page generator, using our master template. Upkeep and edit master templates as needed. - Do keyword research: long-tail, intent-driven, clustered, one primary keyword per page. - Earn 100 quality backlinks per month (DR 30–50+) through manual outreach. The build must include: • Seamless payment gateway integration (multiple providers preferred for redundancy). • A robust inventory management setup that syncs stock in real time. • A product review system that lets verified buyers leave ratings and photos.
Beyond those essentials, I’d like clean, responsive styling, fast loading times, and straightforward options for future add-ons such as marketing plugins or multilingual support. Once the site is live I’ll handle day-to-day content updates myself, so clear admin documentation is important.
If you have solid WooCommerce experience and can commit to regular progress check-ins, I’d love to hear how you’d approach this build and the timeline you’d need to deliver the finished store.

item.title: React Developer – Figma to Pixel-Perfect Marketing Site
item.description:
2-8 USD/hr | We have a fully designed marketing website in Figma and need an experienced frontend developer to translate it into production-quality React code. This is an implementation project — the design is finalized and we need precise, clean code that matches it exactly.
Requirements: - Strong proficiency in React (functional components, hooks) - Experience working with Lovable (formerly GPT Engineer) or similar AI-assisted React platforms - Proven ability to implement pixel-perfect UI from Figma designs - Solid understanding of HTML5 and modern CSS (Flexbox, Grid, responsive design) - Ability to work within an existing React project structure without breaking current functionality - Attention to detail — we expect the final output to match the Figma spec closely - Experience with marketing/landing page builds is a plus
Deliverables: - Fully implemented React components matching the provided Figma designs - Responsive layout that works across desktop, tablet, and mobile - Clean, maintainable code integrated into our existing React/Lovable project - Any necessary assets properly handled (images, icons, fonts) - Final review pass to ensure visual accuracy against the Figma file
Work Arrangement: This is a fixed-scope project based on implementing an already-completed Figma design into an existing codebase. We expect a relatively fast turnaround from a developer who can hit the ground running.
About the project: We are building a marketing website for an ecommerce brand and the design phase is complete — we simply need a skilled developer to bring it to life in React with precision and professionalism.

item.title: Full-Service Amazon Store Management
item.description:
8-15 USD/hr | We're launching an Amazon store and need a comprehensive, end-to-end management service. We need you to build out the store design per our concepts. And then expert marketing to drive visibility and sales. Mainly clothing, accessories, home & living items.
Requirements: - Store setup and product listing: We need an appealing and optimized store, with all products listed professionally from the get-go. - Product sourcing: We expect high-quality, trendy clothing that's competitively priced. - Inventory management: Efficient tracking and management of stock levels. - Customer service and returns: Excellent customer service to handle inquiries and returns promptly and professionally.
Ideal Skills: - Proven experience in e-commerce, particularly on Amazon - Strong background in marketing and promotions - Excellent inventory management skills - Customer service expertise - Proven positive track record with end to end Amazon store management. - Experience with Printful to Amazon integrations (Not required but useful)
We will be using Printful as our print-on-demand and dropshipping service. It integrates with Amazon. Please familiarize yourself with that platform.
